app.Response.description: The Response struct is used for wrapping the API response with a code, message, and data.

code.description:
Code is the HTTP status code or a custom code used to indicate the result of the request
@example 200

data.description:
Data is the response data (can be any object or null)
@example {"id": 1, "name": "John Doe"}

msg.description:
Msg is the message that describes the result of the request
@example "Request successful"

info.description: Crawlora is a hosted web-data and SERP API: call documented REST endpoints and get normalized JSON instead of HTML to parse — across search/SERP, maps and local, e-commerce, app stores, social, media and finance. One API key; Crawlora runs the proxy rotation, headless browsers and parsing behind the scenes. Billed pay-on-success: charged only on a successful 2xx response, 1-10 credits per call, with a free tier of 2,000 credits per month and no card. A hosted MCP server (mcp.crawlora.net/mcp) exposes the same catalog as agent tools. Search endpoints accept `q` as a universal alias for whichever search-term parameter they document (`query`, `term`, `keyword`, or Amazon's `k`), so one parameter name works across the whole catalog; an explicitly supplied documented name always wins.
info.title: Crawlora API

get.description: Lists page titles on one Liquipedia wiki using MediaWiki list=allpages. Supports source namespace, prefix/range, redirect, language-link, size, protection, ordering, page-size, and continuation filters. Use liquipedia_enums for namespace and closed filter values. Results include Liquipedia attribution and CC BY-SA 3.0 license metadata.

parameters.description: Source page title to start enumeration from
parameters.name: apfrom

parameters.description: Source page title to stop enumeration at
parameters.name: apto

parameters.description: Source namespace ID; discover IDs with liquipedia_enums
parameters.name: apnamespace

parameters.description: Maximum page size in bytes; MediaWiki may disable this under miser mode
parameters.name: apmaxsize

parameters.description: Page size from 1 through 500, or max; source default is 10
parameters.name: aplimit

get.summary: Enumerate pages on a Liquipedia wiki

get.description: Returns pages linking to a source-selected target title or page ID through MediaWiki list=backlinks. Supports namespace and redirect filters, native page limits, redirect-target expansion, and continuation. Returned page records include their Liquipedia page URLs and CC BY-SA 3.0 attribution metadata.

parameters.description: Target page title; mutually exclusive with blpageid
parameters.name: bltitle

parameters.description: Target page ID; mutually exclusive with bltitle
parameters.name: blpageid

parameters.description: Repeatable referring-page namespace ID filter, or * for all
parameters.name: blnamespace

parameters.description: Page size from 1 through 500, or max; source default is 10
parameters.name: bllimit

parameters.description: Include backlinks to redirects of the target page
parameters.name: blredirect

get.summary: List Liquipedia pages linking to a page

get.description: Lists source categories on one Liquipedia wiki using MediaWiki list=allcategories. Supports native prefix/range filters, member-count bounds, size/hidden properties, and continuation. Results carry Liquipedia attribution and CC BY-SA 3.0 license metadata.

parameters.description: First category title to enumerate from
parameters.name: acfrom

parameters.description: Last category title to enumerate to
parameters.name: acto

parameters.description: Page size from 1 through 500, or max; source default is 10
parameters.name: aclimit

get.summary: Enumerate categories on a Liquipedia wiki

get.description: Lists pages in a category on one Liquipedia wiki with source page IDs, titles, member types, optional sort metadata, and native continuation tokens. Provide exactly one of cmtitle or cmpageid. Use liquipedia_enums for namespace, member type, property, sort, and direction values. Returned wiki metadata is CC BY-SA 3.0 with attribution.

parameters.description: Category title including Category:; mutually exclusive with cmpageid
parameters.name: cmtitle

parameters.description: Category page ID; mutually exclusive with cmtitle
parameters.name: cmpageid

parameters.description: Repeatable source namespace ID filter, or * for all
parameters.name: cmnamespace

parameters.description: Page size, 1 through 500, or max (source default 10)
parameters.name: cmlimit

parameters.description: Hex sort-key start bound for cmsort=sortkey
parameters.name: cmstarthexsortkey

parameters.description: Hex sort-key end bound for cmsort=sortkey
parameters.name: cmendhexsortkey

parameters.description: Sort-key prefix start bound for cmsort=sortkey
parameters.name: cmstartsortkeyprefix

parameters.description: Sort-key prefix end bound for cmsort=sortkey
parameters.name: cmendsortkeyprefix

get.description: Returns live namespace IDs for one wiki plus the accepted search, links, backlinks, category-member, all-pages, all-categories, prefix-search, recent-changes, and tag filter values and page-size ranges supported by this API. Use the tags tool for current dynamic tag names. Results include Liquipedia attribution and CC BY-SA 3.0 license metadata.

Returns outgoing wiki links for source-selected page titles, page IDs, or revision IDs through MediaWiki prop=links. Supports namespace filtering, linked-title filtering, native page limits, redirects, and continuation. Each source page and linked title includes its Liquipedia page URL; results carry CC BY-SA 3.0 attribution metadata.

parameters.description: Source page title; mutually exclusive with pageids and revids
parameters.name: titles

parameters.description: Source page ID; mutually exclusive with titles and revids
parameters.name: pageids

parameters.description: Source revision ID; mutually exclusive with titles and pageids
parameters.name: revids

parameters.description: Repeatable linked-page namespace ID filter, or * for all
parameters.name: plnamespace

parameters.description: Page size from 1 through 500, or max; source default is 10
parameters.name: pllimit

parameters.description: Optional source title filter, up to 50 titles
parameters.name: pltitles

get.description: Gets one wiki page through MediaWiki action=parse. Provide exactly one of page, pageid, or oldid; an optional section selects one page section. Parsed content has media assets and active HTML removed. The response includes the source page URL, attribution, and CC BY-SA 3.0 license metadata; redistribute derivatives under the same or a compatible license.

parameters.description: Source page title; mutually exclusive with pageid and oldid
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: Source page ID; mutually exclusive with page and oldid
parameters.name: pageid

parameters.description: Source revision ID; mutually exclusive with page and pageid
parameters.name: oldid

parameters.description: Source section number or anchor ID
parameters.name: section

get.description: Uses MediaWiki list=prefixsearch to return best-matching page titles for a search prefix. Namespace IDs are discovered with liquipedia_enums; source search profiles, page limits, offsets, and continuation are forwarded. Results include page links, Liquipedia attribution, and CC BY-SA 3.0 license metadata.

parameters.description: Repeatable namespace ID filter, or * for all; discover namespace IDs with liquipedia_enums
parameters.name: psnamespace

parameters.description: Page size from 1 through 500, or max; source default is 10
parameters.name: pslimit

get.summary: Suggest matching page titles on a Liquipedia wiki

get.description: Lists recent wiki changes using MediaWiki list=recentchanges, with native time, namespace, tag, type, visibility, page-title, ordering, and continuation filters. Editor identities, edit comments and log information are returned when requested through rcprop. Change tags are discoverable with liquipedia_tags; numeric namespaces are discoverable with liquipedia_enums. Results include Liquipedia attribution and CC BY-SA 3.0 license metadata.

parameters.description: Repeatable namespace ID, or * for all; discover namespace IDs with liquipedia_enums
parameters.name: rcnamespace

parameters.description: Repeatable metadata field, including user, userid, comment, parsedcomment and loginfo; permission-restricted patrolled is not supported
parameters.name: rcprop

parameters.description: Page size from 1 through 500, or max; source default is 10
parameters.name: rclimit

get.summary: List recent changes on a Liquipedia wiki

get.description: Searches a selected Liquipedia wiki through its public MediaWiki API. Returns matching page IDs, titles, text snippets, page links, and native continuation data. Use a wiki slug from liquipedia_wikis and namespace/filter values from liquipedia_enums. Search ranking controls include the source query-independent and query-dependent profiles. Snippets and other wiki text are CC BY-SA 3.0 and carry source attribution.

parameters.description: Repeatable source namespace ID filter, or * for all
parameters.name: srnamespace

parameters.description: Page size, 1 through 500, or max (source default 10)
parameters.name: srlimit

get.description: Lists the current MediaWiki change-tag names and optional native metadata. Use the returned tag names with liquipedia_recent_changes rctag. Results include Liquipedia attribution and CC BY-SA 3.0 license metadata.

parameters.description: Page size from 1 through 500, or max; source default is 10
parameters.name: tglimit

get.summary: List change tags on a Liquipedia wiki

get.description: Returns the current set of Liquipedia wiki prefixes and canonical wiki URLs from the Commons MediaWiki interwiki map. Use a returned wiki slug with liquipedia_enums, liquipedia_search, liquipedia_category_members, and liquipedia_page. Results include Liquipedia attribution and CC BY-SA 3.0 license metadata.
